title: Cloud auto mode closer to desktop bypass: allow the safe acts
why: Cloud sessions stop to ask, or are refused, far more often than the owner's desktop bypass mode.
note:
13:40 CST Nov 7: the lane's three acts (sha-form lease push to own branch, cancel own CI run, delete own check-in) already have the owner's grant (items 257 a, 278 c and d; 13:16 CST chat). Triage folded them into item 353 as a typed go line, not a new question. Drafts: branches lease-sha-form-hint and own-branch-lease-push-tests.
Folded into lane relayed-yes-allow (coordinator, 13:40 CST Nov 7): one owner go, item 350.
Owner ask ask-mw5av97rcg (12:20 CST): "a better middle ground". List the acts most often asked about or refused (guard.log, refusal notes), then propose allow lines for the safe ones. The list goes to the owner for approval, because it changes what auto mode allows. Survey done (coordinator, 13:55 CST Nov 7). Its three acts go to lane lease-push-c-and-d. Idle-lane audit (triage, 03:26 CST Nov 8): lane session_013NEJKzw6Mmu5eviHC3vobt is idle. Sent to the coordinator. Owner item 450 a (page answer 18:39 CST Nov 8): add all three autoMode.allow entries: (1) Merge Tool Read Checks (`merge <pr> --reviewed`, `--lane-lint`, `--review-record`; never --confirm, force or the ok flags); (2) a lane closes a PR it replaced with one it opened in the same session, `Replaced by #n` in the body; (3) a lease-push call may chain a plain archive push to refs/heads/archive/<b>. A settings write needs the owner's words typed in the acting session; a page pick is no grant there (P43), so the lane's PR merges under review and the owner's merge word, or he adds the entries as with his 18:31 CST push. Coordinator 18:37-18:38 CST Nov 8 sent a corrected question (a = lanes change, no entry; b and c widens:true with the ruling line; plus a Based on (ruling) line on lease-push-c-and-d). Triage read those messages only at 18:42 CST, after the owner saved, so the page showed triage's 18:37 version, where a = add all three with no widens flag. The owner's 450 a is add all three; the coordinator routed it to lane relayed-yes-allow, PR after the owner's four entries land. Gap (note): triage's 18:37 CST item 450 left widens:true and the ruling line off two options that add allow-list entries, against style-question-form, and the question-form check let the page write through.
